faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need a card for the trial?
faq.a1: No. The trial is 14 days with no card.
faq.a2: Yes. Arabic RTL is the default; English is available.
faq.q3: Can employees use it on their phones?
faq.a3: Yes. Kadr is a Progressive Web App they can install.
faq.a4: Salary structure and a monthly run with review, approve, and lock. Your company controls the rules. Loans, payslip PDFs, and bank files are not claimed here.
